title: Kiugrási kísérlet és nyilas terror (Failed Armistice & Arrow Cross Terror)
grammar: Causal Triggers, Tragedy Descriptors & Historical Memorial Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe Horthy's failed armistice attempt and the Arrow Cross terror in 1944.
I can say that an attempt failed, with kísérletet tesz and meghiúsul.
I can say what happened in Budapest on 15 October 1944.
I can use six words about October 1944, such as nyilas terror and Szálasi Ferenc.
